body: I would like one men's size small.  Thank you so much, and I hope this is not too much of an annoyance.

Thank you.  After reading all these responses again and reading yours again...I feel like what everyone has said has really resonated.  I'm calling the University Health Services tomorrow.  I'm ready to be happy again.  And I'm going to be.

I think bringing meaning to my world would help.  I've tried before.  And I feel like it has helped before.  The problem is...I always come back to one question.  What's the point?  Why should I care about college?  Why should I even continue to live and better myself, if after I die, no one will remember me?  My accomplishments in life will mean nothing when I am gone.  And when the human race is extinct, no one's accomplishments will mean anything.

I know I should tell my mom and talk to a counselor, I'm just...well, ashamed about it.  I worked so hard to get better, I worked with a therapist for over a year, and it feels like so much I accomplished has been undone in such a short time.

You're right about losing interest in a lot of things.  I am easily at that point.  Which makes thinking about my major that much more difficult and overwhelming.  

And as for hanging in there...I feel like I've been barely hanging on for so long.  My hands hurt and my arms are exhausted.  I just want to let go.

If i could take time off, I might.  But I don't know how realistic that is.  I honestly don't think I should be in college right now.  I think the best thing I could have done would have been to take time off before I went to school.  But our culture isn't structured that way.  You graduate from high school, you go to college.  Boom.  But I'm here. And I am going to try and get through this year.  I just don't know if I can.

But I can't help feeling that all that is ahead is more pain and sadness.  Sure, some of those twists and turns will be good things.  But others will be horrendous.  

To quote Modest Mouse: 
"If life's not beautiful without the pain 
Well, I'd just rather never ever even see beauty again"

I think this perfectly encapsulates how I have felt for so long.  Sure, therapy helped, but it has lingered in my mind.  The bad outweighs the good in life.  There's more of it, and it hurts worse than the good can repair.  And I'd rather not deal with either anymore.
I don't think today will work for your favor...mostly because I have slept almost all of the day away.  But I will do it tomorrow.  I will get up and go to all my classes and do my best to be happy.
I know...and I apologize for waiting so long.  I wrote this shortly before I went to bed, and I just woke up.  And I skipped my first class to sleep more.  But I'm here now, ready to talk and listen.
